comments.text: Life After LAYOFF?? If he got laid off, he had NO choice, so he gets MAJOR kudos for pivoting and making the best of a sh*tty situation. If he quit, he did that a$$backwards - he should have paid off debt, saved up a cushy emergency fund and then left, it's called adulting: putting your big boy pants on and keeping your eye on the prize, while you grit your teeth and bear the work bullsh*t til you are debt-free with an EF.
